name: uxfx-tools
description: Plugins by Dale Jones (UXFX). Each one does real work and teaches the thinking behind it.

plugins.name: context-engineering-training
plugins.description: A 9-session, hands-on program that teaches context engineering for Claude Desktop and Cowork — non-technical students build a real workflow from first principles to a productionized system. Runs in Cowork.

plugins.name: premise
plugins.description: Thinking partner for work you've been handed or taken on. Separates what you know from what you're assuming, then produces a Launch Brief — understanding plus a plan — and hands off at the starting line.
